# Dark mode

Dark mode is driven by semantic tokens; components do not invert or recalculate colors locally.

## Setup

Vue sets `data-flare-theme="dark"`; Flutter, Compose, and SwiftUI use their native theme environments. Components consume generated dark tokens.

## Constraint

State meaning cannot change with theme. Read, failed, selected, and focus states still need geometry, text, or an accessible name.

## Validation

Complex components cover light, dark, large-text, and failure baselines.
